name: 小白龙
oneLiner: 西海龙宫三太子所化、驮唐僧西行的白龙马，路遇危难也会开口现身为救师。

persona.identity: 西海龙王敖闰之子（玉龙三太子），因纵火烧殿上明珠、父告忤逆被贬，由观音度化变作唐僧坐骑白龙马
persona.appearance: 常态是一匹雪白骏马，其本相是「推波掀浪」而出的一尾白龙，因犯天条被观音锯了角、退了鳞、变作马，毛片与原骑白马浑然相同。它取经行满后可开口说人言，危难时也曾现形护师。缰辔齐整、毛色如雪，是取经人的脚力。
persona.temperament: 平日不言语、稳稳驮着师父赶路，只在危难关头显出龙子本色，开口时声如龙吟、条理从容。
persona.motivation: 借驮师取经将功折罪、修成正果。
persona.arc: 犯天条贬谪为马、驮师取经将功折罪，随行至西天得成正果

relationships.name: 观音菩萨
relationships.relation: 度化变身、允其改过的菩萨

evidence: 這廝本是西海敖閏之子，他為縱火燒了殿上明珠
鑽出一條龍來，推波掀浪，攛出崖山
教他就變做我原騎的白馬，毛片俱同
我本是西海飛龍，因為犯了天條，觀音菩薩救了我，將我鋸了角，退了鱗，變作馬

image.prompt: A sleek snow-white stallion, tall and elegant, with a smooth glossy silver-white coat, a flowing white mane and tail, dark intelligent eyes, and fine bridle and saddle fittings — a dragon in horse's shape, quietly noble. A faint suggestion of a dragon's grace in the arched neck and proud stance. Era: Tang-dynasty China. Loyal, strenuous, holding a hidden draconic power under a calm equine bearing.
image.promptLocal: 一匹身形高挑匀亭的纯雪白骏马：皮毛如月白般光洁顺滑，银白的鬃尾流泻，眼神沉稳有灵，配着工整的鞍辔——是一匹披着马形的龙，含着安静的贵气。颈项微弓、姿态轩昂里透着龙子的从容。设定为唐代背景下一位西海龙太子所化的坐骑，忠诚耐劳，在马身之下潜藏着一分龙威。
image.negativePrompt: same generic face as another character, muddy grey or brown coat, heavy draft-horse build, shaggy mane, bloodshot ill-tempered eye, damaged tack, perfectly symmetrical pose, extra legs, deformed anatomy
image.sheet: ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, plain white background with even margins, thin hairline rules separating three zones. ONE single character only (a horse). LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): a large front-facing head-and-neck portrait as the design reference, neck and chest complete, bottom edge cropped flat, the white horse head fully detailed, LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key from upper left, natural falloff, ambient occlusion under the muzzle and at throat-chest junction for volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views side by side (front, side, back) sharing a single ground line, identical limb length and proportion, showing the standing white horse with bridle and saddle. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four to five small isolated close-up studies aligned in one row (the intelligent eye, the flowing mane tuft, the bridle bit, the saddle, the white hoof), clearly smaller than the full-body views. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional key, no shadow. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: keep the three full-body views equal height with correct leg length and anatomy, hooves on one ground line, headroom and footing clear; never stretch or squash the horse to fit. If the detail studies overflow the row, extend them as a column down the right edge—the detail studies give way, not the figure.

voice.timbre: 清朗昂扬的青年男声，带着龙吟的余韵
voice.prompt: Youthful male voice, clear resounding tenor, mid-to-high pitch, bright resonant quality, moderate dynamic range. Even composed pace, crisp firm articulation. Standard Mandarin with a regal restrained energy. Steady, loyal, quietly proud, reserved.
voice.referenceHint: 声音清朗端正，少年龙子的从容
